# About me 

::: grid
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-6}


***`I`m quite interested*** in the different aspects of political economy and economic history. This was sparked by my activity with Rethinking Economics, a global network of students who want to change the way economics is taught and practiced. On this website I collect various projects and ideas, adorned with a bunch of  Vermeer paintings (like the one on this page: ["The Geographer"](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Geographer) )

### My ideological inspiration

and their respective newsletters:

- ***Thomas Piketty***: [LeMonde](https://www.ft.com/alphaville)
- ***Adam Tooze***: [Chartbook](https://adamtooze.substack.com/)
- ***Branko Milanovic***: [Global Inequality and More 3.0](https://branko2f7.substack.com/)
